requirements.text: Store each account's preferred time zone.
Return the preference through the account API.
Do not change notification scheduling in this migration.

coverage_ledger.reason: The schema prerequisite and write path jointly deliver storage.
The vertical API ticket exposes the stored preference.
The source requirement explicitly preserves scheduling behavior.

tickets.title: Add the account time-zone column
tickets.outcome: The database can persist an optional account time zone.
in_scope: Add the nullable column and migration verification.
out_of_scope: Read or write the field through the API.
acceptance: A migrated database accepts the new column.

tickets.title: Expose account time-zone preferences
tickets.outcome: Clients can save and read an account time-zone preference.
in_scope: Add API validation, persistence, and response serialization.
acceptance: The account API round-trips a valid IANA time zone.
validation: Run the account API integration test.

consumes.output: The migrated account table with the optional time-zone column.
